### The Ark Comes to the Temple
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ark-comes-to-the-temple
Passage: 2 Chronicles 5:1-6:11
Points:
- Following the temple's completion, Solomon brought David's dedicated treasures and the ark of the covenant into the new sanctuary.
- The elders and priests gathered to escort the sacred vessels into the Most Holy Place amid countless sacrifices.
- As musicians and singers praised the Lord in unified worship, the cloud of God's glory visibly filled the house.
- Solomon addressed the assembly, testifying that God had faithfully fulfilled His covenant promises to David.
- While the Creator cannot be contained by any physical structure, believers can be certain of His presence whenever they gather for worship.
